title: Aether Infusion
description: Allows players to extract enchantments from items using an anvil and transfer them to books without consuming experience levels.
body:
# ✨ Aether Infusion

**Aether Infusion** allows you to extract enchantments from any enchanted item and transfer them to a book — without spending a single level of experience.

---

## 🔧 How It Works

| Left Slot (Anvil) | Right Slot (Anvil) | Output |
|:-----------------:|:------------------:|:------:|
| Enchanted Item | Book | Enchanted Book |

1. Place an **enchanted item** in the left slot of an anvil
2. Place a **regular book** in the right slot
3. Take the **enchanted book** from the output slot

> ⚠️ **Warning:** The original item will be **consumed** in the process. Make sure you no longer need the item before extracting its enchantments!

---



## 📦 Requirements

- **Minecraft:** 1.21.1
- **Mod Loader:** NeoForge 21.1.226+
- **Side:** Server-side (clients don't need it)
